Threat_Scenario: Forged JWT via Key Confusion (alg: none / public key HMAC misuse)
Prescribed_Mitigation: Strict JWKS verification, RS256/ES256 whitelist, reject alg:none, validate iss and aud claims against Entra ID.
Verification_Method: Automated negative test injecting unsigned and HMAC-tampered tokens expecting HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

Threat_Scenario: Pod-to-Pod cleartext lateral snooping and payload manipulation across flat cluster network
Prescribed_Mitigation: Enforce strict Istio/Cilium mutual TLS (mTLS) with SPIFFE cryptographic workload identity and default-deny Cilium NetworkPolicies.
Verification_Method: eBPF packet monitoring confirming encrypted streams; cross-namespace lateral traffic actively dropped.

Threat_Scenario: Rogue actor or compromised service deletes or alters plain database transaction audit trails
Prescribed_Mitigation: Stream audit events synchronously to Amazon S3 Object Lock in Compliance Mode with KMS HMAC signing.
Verification_Method: Attempt programmatic deletion of audit objects using cluster admin credentials; verify API call fails with 403 AccessDenied.

Threat_Scenario: Exfiltration of customer PII and cardholder data via compromised service credentials or SQL injection
Prescribed_Mitigation: Implement AWS KMS envelope encryption for sensitive database columns; replace static secrets with IAM ephemeral DB authentication.
Verification_Method: Direct raw DB extraction returns ciphertext; verify IAM DB auth tokens expire automatically in 15 minutes.

Threat_Scenario: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion caused by unindexed recursive search queries from external clients
Prescribed_Mitigation: Deploy AWS WAF rate-based rules (300 req/5min per IP), PgBouncer connection pooling, and route analytical reads to Aurora Read Replicas.
Verification_Method: Load stress test at 5,000 req/sec; confirm edge WAF triggers HTTP 429 while write latency remains unaffected.

Threat_Scenario: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR) allows arbitrary fund deductions by tampering account_id in payment payload
Prescribed_Mitigation: Fine-grained contextual authorization using Open Policy Agent (OPA) validating token subject claim against destination account ownership.
Verification_Method: Automated security integration test swapping user GUID in transaction payload triggers immediate HTTP 403 Forbidden.
